rawContent:
#MeToo has really changed things. Between Weinstein, Charlie Rose last wk. & Matt Lauer today, companies are cleaning house. Although I don't know the FULL stories & try NOT to judge, I applaud these women for coming forward. 👏🏽

I'm gonna quote a post from earlier this month: https://t.co/9rVfBlJvZt

So far I've watched the first 3 episodes of #ShesGottaHaveIt. I appreciate the beautiful sistas, the #BLM themes, the old R&B/Hip-Hop soundtracks, Mars' love for MJ, & the unapologetic Blackness. 

Thanks to @ARichmondnews for putting me on this show. ❤️🖤💚✊🏽

I love that Kaepernick has really been putting in the work and wants to continue to fight the good fight against racial injustice, even without football. Much respect to him. ✊🏽 #BlackTwitter #BlackUnity #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/bVrIoJ7sHf
So sad to hear about Erica Garner. It was not that long ago that we also lost Eric Garner. My prayers for her and her family. RIP. 🙏🏽 #BlackTwitter #BlackLivesMatter
